# Kilotest

Kilotest integrates an ensemble of 12 rule engines, with about 1,300 rules, to test web pages for front-end quality (accessibility, usability, and web standards, including HTML, CSS, ARIA, and WCAG, including HTML, CSS, ARIA, and WCAG). Each test job generates a standardized report describing which elements violated which rules and grouping the violations into about 380 issues. Kilotest can list the tested pages, the reports about each page, the issues in each report, the violators of each issue, and the diagnoses of each violation. Kilotest also accepts requests to test pages not yet tested and to retest already tested pages. Kilotest features are available via a web UI, an API, and an MCP server with streamable HTTP and no authentication.

## API

- [List all tested pages, each with its latest report](/api/listPages) (`GET`)
- List all issues in one report, and all reports about the same page: `/api/listIssues/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`GET`)
- List all elements exhibiting one issue in one report: `/api/listViolators/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`GET`)
- List all diagnoses of one element exhibiting one issue in one report: `/api/listDiagnoses/{catalogIndex}/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`GET`)
- Get one full report in JSON: `/api/getReport/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`GET`)
- Request testing of a web page: `/api/requestNewTest` (`POST`)
- Request retesting of a web page: `/api/requestRetest/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`POST`)
- Request adding or improving a feature: `/api/requestFeature` (`POST`)
- Order immediate, automatically approved testing of a web page: `/api/orderNewTest` (`POST`)
- Order immediate, automatically approved retesting of a web page: `/api/orderRetest/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`POST`)
- Wait for a job ordered via orderNewTest or orderRetest to complete: `/api/awaitTest/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`POST`)

## MCP Server

- [MCP server for Kilotest](https://kilotest.com/mcp)

## Web UI

- [List all tested pages, each linked to its latest report](https://kilotest.com/listPages.html)
- List all issues in one report, and all reports about the same page: `https://kilotest.com/listIssues.html/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- List all elements exhibiting one issue in one report: `https://kilotest.com/listViolators.html/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- List all diagnoses of one element exhibiting one issue in one report: `https://kilotest.com/listDiagnoses.html/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}/{catalogIndex}`
- Get one full report in JSON: `https://kilotest.com/fullReport.json/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- [Request testing of a web page](https://kilotest.com/requestNewTestForm.html)
- Request retesting of a web page: `https://kilotest.com/requestRetestForm.html/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- [List the operations that Kilotest managers are authorized to request](https://kilotest.com/manage.html)
- [Provide statistics about frequently reported issues across all pages](https://kilotest.com/listTopIssues.html)
- [Tutorial, “Accessibility testing strategies”](https://kilotest.com/tutorial.html)
